governance_boundary: This finite incidence package does not certify external support, consciousness, phenomenality, identity transfer, bridge-burden closure, or human mathematical review. It is an internal synthetic formal witness only.
independence_boundary: The package is constructed from a declared finite separator catalog, finite response-coordinate catalog, predeclared admission rules, and typed perturbation records. The construction does not assume separator atomicity; atomicity is only inferred later if the independently declared incidence graph passes the connectedness and completeness audit.
intended_theorem_use: Negative control: this package should fail connected-incidence atomicity because it is a product-separator incidence graph with two disconnected factors.

finite_universe_policy.factor_nontriviality_rule: each factor side must contain at least one response-operative separator and at least one response coordinate
finite_universe_policy.zero_crossing_factor_locality_rule: a factor-local decomposition has no incidence edge crossing the cut
finite_universe_policy.anti_selection_rule: separator and response vertices are deliberately factor-local in this negative control
